question:
Create a new KiCad project named b34 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Build the SMD version of an ATmega328P DRAM tester: TQFP-32 MCU, 16 MHz crystal, parallel DIP-20 ZIF and ZIP-20 514256-style sockets, USB-C power only, and standard AVR ICSP. Firmware assigns PD0-PD7 to A0-A7, PB4 to A8, PC0-PC3 to I/O1-I/O4, PB0/PB1/PB2/PB3 to nCAS/nRAS/nOE/nWE, and PC4 to the sockets' reserved contact. Use four 4x47 ohm resistor packs for the eight low address, four data and four control lines, with separate 47 ohm resistors for A8 and the reserved contact.
The three DIP-switch options pull socket-side A2, A3 and the PC5/socket-power node high; use 1M pull-downs. Fit a reset button, reset pull-up, supply bypassing, USB input fuse/ferrite/ESD protection and CC sink resistors. ADC6 is grounded and ADC7 is at 5 V. The dual common-anode result LED is driven by BSS138 low-side switches controlled by SCK and MISO, with 390/150 ohm LED resistors. The display header is GND, 5 V, SCK, MISO. Represent the removable memories as sockets with the standard 514256 DIP/ZIP signal pinouts.
If socket symbols are unavailable, define labeled connectors with these pin orders. DIP pins 1-20: I/O1, I/O2, nWE, nRAS, reserved, A0, A1, A2, A3, VCC, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, nOE, nCAS, I/O3, I/O4, GND. ZIP pins 1-20: nOE, nCAS, I/O3, I/O4, GND, I/O1, I/O2, nWE, nRAS, reserved, A0, A1, A2, A3, VCC, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8.
Local dependencies: No project-local libraries are supplied. Use standard KiCad parts where available; define missing module/connector symbols from the interfaces specified above.
